scope.role: Visual reviewer; physical image inspection through functions.view_image; filesystem audit and source edit owner; no Unity commands or image generation during this review.
scope.verdictMeaning: Pass for the bounded art2 changes: no newly introduced visual blocker observed. This does not claim pixel-for-pixel concept identity or human art approval.
limits: Still-image comparison demonstrates consistent relative prop placement across the supplied zoom/pan views; runtime geometry and collision claims require the separate Unity regression evidence.
Single streak is visibly short in trial frames. Battle frames include the preserved long Line effect and do not independently exercise every attack-family phase.
Scroll input was not operated by this read-only reviewer; compact inspector continuation and scrollbars are recorded as visible residuals.

sourceInspection.method: functions.view_image; actual raster returned and interpreted
observations: Three large illustrative combat rows with ink bullets and densely illustrated periphery; right comparison table and primary test action.

sourceInspection.method: functions.view_image; actual raster returned and interpreted
observations: The open defensive centre has a crowned castle, circular gun platforms, barricades and support buildings.
Dense pine and rock groups frame the field, with three coloured ink wells on rocky plateaus.
A full eight-slot loadout and material/colour/action row sit below the field; four red approach arrows point toward the castle.

sourceInspection.method: functions.view_image; actual raster returned and interpreted
observations: A dense fifth-wave attack approaches the central castle from four sides, among forest islands, rocks and coloured ink wells.
Short blue ordinary bullets and dashed trajectories differ from the large impact splashes; visible enemies and wells have attached health bars.
The eight-slot loadout remains below the live field with material, colour and action controls.

sourceInspection.method: functions.view_image; actual raster returned and interpreted
observations: A large paper inspector on the right shows a twin-weapon circular tower, a 47/55 health bar, real stat rows and three priority choices.
The battle remains visible to the left: castle, barricades, repair and generator buildings, surrounding pines/rocks, enemies and ink impact effects.
The bottom loadout and action controls stay visible while the inspector is open.

observations: Физически просмотрен боевой кадр: сосны остаются на тех же местах, что при планировании; замок и реальные боевые постройки не закрыты.
Длинный диагональный след пробивающего оружия сохранён, как требуется для Line; обычные Single отдельно проверены на кадрах полигона.
Счётчики подходов и противников, полосы здоровья видимых врагов, вся нижняя колода и управление скоростью читаемы.
residuals: Кадр снят на первой реальной волне, поэтому плотность врагов и эффектов ниже иллюстративной пятой волны эскиза.
Четыре отдельные одинаковые сосны пока не воспроизводят насыщенные природные группы исходника.
В ближнем виде враги за границей кадра представлены счётчиками подходов; часть силуэта может естественно обрезаться краем камеры.

observations: Физически просмотрен вариант генератора: правильный отдельный механизм, прочность 80/80, материал, цвет и цена 60 штрихов помещаются.
